workspaceLineage.headerPresentation: Persistent compact Project menu plus Scenario / Version / draft summary; summary opens a keyboard-accessible details popover.
workspaceLineage.draftSemantics: Unsaved changes is independent of autosaved local persistence and does not create an immutable Version.

resultContext.sourceRule: If a Run exists, its retained ScenarioRevision/canonical snapshot owns the source. A missing Run revision is not filled with the currently active Version.
resultContext.freshnessRule: Use exact known identity mismatch, existing invalidation, and comparable existing fingerprints; timestamps never establish freshness.
resultContext.restoredResultRule: If result UI state exists but no unambiguous current Run association is retained, report UNAVAILABLE rather than guessing by time.

surfaces.density: compact; popover holds the complete workspace identity

content: Run again / View Run where safe

identityDisplay.default: Short Run ID and user-facing Scenario/Version labels.
identityDisplay.runDate: Use the same Run.created_at source in Results, Run History, and Report context.
